subtitle: Multifamily · 48 units · San Diego, CA
meta: Internal — broker use only · demo sample

sections.heading: Opening — 15 seconds
sections.coach: Direct and unhurried. Reason for the call in the first breath.
say: Hi [NAME], Julie Chasen with CRE Northstar. The purpose of my call is a 48-unit multifamily listing we just brought to market in Mission Valley — I think it fits what you've been buying. Did I catch you at a workable moment?

sections.heading: The hook
say: It's Hillcrest Gardens Apartments — 48 units, asking $10,950,000, and it's coming to market at a 6.33% cap on in-place income.

sections.heading: Value stack
sections.coach: One number per line. Pause after each.
say: That's $228,125 a unit in a submarket where replacement cost runs well above that.
In-place rents are about 8% under market across both floor plans — the upside is in the rent roll, not a renovation budget.
Occupancy has held at 93.6% through the trailing twelve months.

sections.heading: Qualifying questions
say: Are you actively acquiring in San Diego right now?
What are you solving for this year — yield, scale, or a 1031 clock?

sections.heading: Close
say: I'll send the OM today. Do you have 15 minutes Thursday to walk the numbers together? Offers are due August 14, so the timeline matters.

objections.response: Absolutely — it'll be in your inbox today. Most buyers find 15 minutes on the rent roll saves them a week of back-and-forth; can I grab Thursday morning?
At $228,125 a unit with rents 8% under market, the going-in cap understates the stabilized yield. The market will set the final number — that's what the offer process is for.
Understood — what does your timeline look like? I'll send the OM for your file either way, and if someone in your network is active in San Diego, I'd welcome the introduction.

voicemail: Hi [NAME], Julie Chasen with CRE Northstar. We just listed a 48-unit multifamily in Mission Valley at a 6.33% cap — offers due August 14. I'll email the summary now; call me back at (555) 014-0620 if it fits your criteria.
